text:
By Source Staff ,
5 hours ago At 6:00 PM in Dickson County, the temperature is 84.6°F with a light wind out of the east at 5 mph. The sky is clear, and there has been no precipitation recorded.
Earlier today, temperatures reached a high of 85.8°F and dipped to a low of 70.5°F. The wind varied, with gusts up to 8.9 mph earlier. The chance of precipitation was low at 17%, and no rain was recorded throughout the day.
As we move into tonight, expect a low of around 75.7°F with continued clear skies. Winds may increase slightly, gusting up to 5.5 mph. The chance of precipitation decreases to 10%.
There are currently no official weather alerts active in the area. Stay tuned for updates throughout the evening.
